definitions.explanation: The act of hitting or striking someone, especially as an act of violence. A formal word commonly used in legal, police, and news contexts to describe physical assault.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭部|とうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{殴打|おうだ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The victim was struck on the head.

examples.japanese: {殴打|おうだ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{傷害|しょうがい}→傷害：22910_shougai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested for assault causing injury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ→防犯カメラ：07137_bouhankamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{殴打|おうだ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}っていた→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The security camera footage showed the suspect striking the victim.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word that appears almost exclusively in news reports, police records, and legal documents. In everyday speech, ⟦{殴|なぐ}る→殴る：02378_naguru⟧ (to punch) or ⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ (to hit) are used instead. Often seen in crime reporting alongside terms like ⟦{傷害|しょうがい}→傷害：22910_shougai⟧ (injury/assault).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殴打|おうだ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to strike, to beat)
- {殴打|おうだ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧ (death by beating)
- {頭部|とうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{殴打|おうだ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to strike on the head)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殴|なぐ}る→殴る：02378_naguru⟧: to punch, to hit — everyday word for striking someone
- ⟦{暴行|ぼうこう}→暴行：27862_boukou⟧: assault, violence — broader legal term covering various types of physical attack
